sentences.en: The lake was frozen, so we walked across the ice.
sentences.zh: 那座湖结冰了，所以我们从冰面上走过。

sentences.en: The hikers were all but frozen when they were found.
sentences.zh: 当搜救队找到他们时，徒步旅行者几乎冻僵了。

sentences.en: She was aware of the danger of the frozen road.
sentences.zh: 她意识到结冰的道路很危险。

senses.zh: 结冰（freeze的过去分词）；凝固；变得刻板
